svg.text: Imperative Deep Learning Framework - ATen + Dispatcher + Autograd - PyTorch 2.x Compiler Stack
Bytecode capture - frame eval hooks - guards
Variable / Node - records ops when requires_grad
Stream / Event abstractions per device type
StorageImpl owns raw memory buffer + refcount
Define-by-run: graph built dynamically at forward time - no static graph required for eager mode
Example: tensor.add(other) with requires_grad=True on CUDA
Step 1: Python a.add(b) - auto-generated C++ binding from native_functions.yaml
Step 2: at::add(x,y) - Dispatcher reads DispatchKeySet from input tensors
Step 3: AutogradCUDA key - record Node - AutoNonVariableTypeMode redispatch
Step 4: CUDA key - at::native::add_cuda kernel executes on GPU
Step 5: Return TensorImpl - backward() traverses graph to compute gradients
Fallthrough keys skipped at static init - BackendSelect routes cross-device ops
CompositeImplicitAutograd ops decompose into simpler ATen primitives automatically
Dynamic Python to fused kernels while preserving PyTorch semantics via guards
Guard fail - recompile or eager fallback - fx_graph_cache avoids repeat compilation
pytorch/pytorch - CUDA/ROCm/MPS/XPU/TPU - Linux Foundation - Meta + community - research to production
Eager path: Python API - Dispatcher - Autograd wrap - backend kernel - dynamic graph on forward
Compile path: Dynamo capture - AOTAutograd - Inductor fuse - Triton/C++ kernel - guard cache - execute
Sources: pytorch/pytorch - ezyang dispatcher blog - native_functions.yaml - PT2 torch.compile docs - PyTorch Foundation
